title: Elimination of Candida Sepsis and Reduction of Several Morbidities in a Tertiary NICU in Greece After Changing Antibiotic, Ventilation, and Nutrition Protocols
content: Background/Objectives: In recent years, strategies for improving outcomes in preterm neonates have been implemented in various aspects of neonatal care. This study aims to determine the prevalence, microbiology, and outcomes of late-onset sepsis (LOS) and the incidence of other morbidities in very preterm neonates following the implementation of specific infection control, enteral feeding, and ventilation strategies.
